environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'shiny' or waxy reflection of the leaves; tactile, smooth bark; clear quadrant separation for educational identification.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single glossy elliptical leaf; Top-Right: A cluster of dark berry-like fruits; Bottom-Left: A slender young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the smooth grey-brown bark.
visual_logic.ground: Rich, dark brown organic soil with a light scattering of fallen green leaves.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to highlight the waxy sheen on the leaf surfaces.
